n: Active Converter Cable, USB-C® to HDMI®, 18 Gbps, 6 ft (1.8 m) (CBL-4K-USBC-HD-6)
d: CBL-4K-USBC-HD-6 Active Converter Cable, USB-C® to HDMI®, 18 Gbps, 6 ft (1.8 m)

specs.label: Functionality
specs.value: Active, directional USB-C to HDMI converter cable

specs.label: Color Sampling
specs.value: 4:4:4 @ 24 bit color depth, 4:2:2 @ 36 bit color depth

specs.label: IN> (Source)
specs.value: (1) USB Type-C connector, male, gold plated, USB-C input

specs.label: OUT> (Sink)
specs.value: (1) HDMI Type A connector, male, gold plated, HDMI output

specs.label: Cable Construction
specs.value: CBL-4K-USBC-HD-6: 30 AWG conductors, double shielded; CBL-4K-USBC-HD-12: 28 AWG conductors, double shielded

specs.label: Cable Length
specs.value: CBL-4K-USBC-HD-6: 6 ft (1.83 m); CBL-4K-USBC-HD-12: 12 ft (3.66 m); nominal including connector boots

specs.label: Cable Outer Diameter
specs.value: CBL-4K-USBC-HD-6: 0.24 in (6 mm) nominal; CBL-4K-USBC-HD-12: 0.28 in (7 mm) nominal

specs.label: Connector Boot Material
specs.value: ABS shell, soft PVC strain relief, black
